chunks: And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Every innovation is misguidance, and every misguidance leads to the Fire.

key_terms.ضَلَالَةٌ: misguidance and deviation from the right path

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean by saying every innovation is misguidance?
ai.summary: This hadith states that every bid'ah is misguidance and that misguidance leads to the Fire. It serves as a warning against religious deviation and emphasizes adherence to the true prophetic tradition.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4954 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"Every innovation is misguidance, and every misguidance leads to the Fire."
